description: Remove an item from a module. For ExternalUrl, ExternalTool and SubHeader items the item is the content, so this deletes it outright; for Assignment, Page, Quiz, File and Discussion items it only unlinks the item and the underlying content survives. Re-add with create_module_item.

item_id.description: The Canvas module item ID to remove

name: delete_module_item
title: Delete Module Item
